summary: RFID garment source tags are applied at the factory during manufacturing — embedding item-level RFID into every garment before it enters the supply chain. Major retailers (Walmart, Target, Macy's, Zara, Nike) now mandate RFID source tagging from suppliers, making factory-applied RFID a requirement for market access.
